One platform.
A clear view of its data.

Current structures verified against Supabase metadata and the application code. Future design ideas are kept in a separate section.

8Detailed domain diagrams
What matters most
  • Accounts are the shared identity. Managed children also have athlete account records; guardian links control parent access.
  • Coach teams and imported school-competition teams are separate structures. The database does not currently connect them.
  • Training verification and team-session attendance are separate records and must not be counted as the same thing.
  • School and club directory entries now map to shared organisations. Profile affiliations are private and separate from access permissions.

Read the diagrams: a circle means zero is allowed; a bar means one; a crow’s foot means many. Solid lines identify a child through its primary key; dotted lines are other enforced foreign keys. Optionality reflects the database, not just the intended screen behaviour.
